summary: Iteration 3 (SSR + SEO/GEO): full backend verification of GET /api/ssr for 10 representative paths plus legacy/alias/error paths, crawler files, OG images, and sitemap. All 28 pytest cases passed (test_ssr_i30.py). Frontend live-preview checks: new /service-areas/new-york and /service-areas/new-jersey render with data-testid='service-area-page', correct <title> and route-specific H1 (not Contact page). Core service pages (cybersecurity, managed-it, cloud, ai, vcio-vciso) render data-testid='page-faqs'. Client-side alias redirects work (/services/managed-support -> /services/managed-it, /about-us -> /about). Home, contact, and existing service pages render with original design, no console/pageerror. Admin login works and dashboard loads. Audit script scripts/audit_seo.py reports 46 pages, 0 issues.

verification_details.ssr_per_page_asserts: unique <title>, meta description, exactly 1 canonical to https://intrinsicamerica.com<path>, og:title/og:description/og:image, twitter tag, exactly 1 <h1>, body text >300 chars, valid JSON-LD
verification_details.sitemap_xml: valid XML; includes /service-areas/new-york and /service-areas/new-jersey; excludes redirect/admin paths

frontend_live.service-areas/new-york: title 'Managed IT Services in New York City | Intrinsic Technology', H1 'Managed IT Services in New York City', data-testid='service-area-page' present
frontend_live.service-areas/new-jersey: title & H1 route-specific for NJ, data-testid='service-area-page' present
frontend_live.service_pages_faqs: data-testid='page-faqs' present on managed-it, cybersecurity, cloud, ai, vcio-vciso
frontend_live.home_contact: render original design, contact form present (1), 0 console errors
frontend_live.admin_login: admin@intrinsictg.com login succeeds; admin dashboard (Overview, Inquiries, Blogs, Service briefs, SEO & GEO, etc.) loads

critical_code_review_comments: SSR is clean: single canonical, unique titles, well-formed JSON-LD (zero parse errors across all 46 audited pages).
Redirect handling via /api/ssr correctly distinguishes 301 (legacy/alias/www), 404 (unknown), and 410 (gone jobs like /jobs/accounting-specialist).
Service-area pages correctly scoped to new-york/new-jersey; both include FAQPage schema plus Service + BreadcrumbList.

/careers/it-project-manager and /careers/sales-representative were audited beyond the required /careers/cloud-solutions-engineer and also produce JobPosting with employmentType/datePosted/hiringOrganization.

In the Emergent preview the dev server still serves the SPA shell for direct URL hits (expected); SSR correctness must be validated via /api/ssr (done). On the VPS nginx proxies HTML requests to /api/ssr.
